material.title: Fictional state announces nomination program opening
material.bodyOriginal: Fictional training example, not a real policy: Example State announces its nomination program opens on 15 September 2026. Only applicants already resident in Example State may apply. Applications lodged before opening are not accepted.

material.title: Guaranteed visa success: join our sales webinar
material.bodyOriginal: Fictional training example: join our sales webinar and buy an education package. We claim guaranteed Australian visa success. No policy document, eligibility criteria or supporting evidence is provided.
